import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0083 {α : Type _} {A B : Set α} (hA : Fintype A) (hB : Fintype B) : card (A \ (A \ B)) = card (B ∩ A) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0083 {α : Type _} {A B : Set α} (hA : Fintype A) (hB : Fintype B) : card (A \ (A \ B)) = card (B ∩ A) := by
  have h1 : A \ (A \ B) = B ∩ A := by
    ext x
    split
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨y, hyA, hyB⟩ := h
      exact ⟨y, hyA, hyB⟩
      
    · intro ⟨y, hyA, hyB⟩
      exact ⟨y, hyA, hyB⟩
      
  exact card_eq_of_subsingleton h1
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0083 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0083 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
